name: r10-ws-l-steal-disp
author: solx-loop
description: A persistent single wave (148 x 8 CTAs of 256 threads) takes tiles from an atomic counter. Tiles are 16 rows, with Q and K interleaved. Each thread issues the next tile's 256-bit loads before reducing the current tile. The idea was to remove the tail and the per-CTA launch cost. The counter is reset with no fence and no extra launch: the CTA whose grab returns the largest possible value makes the last access and resets it.
